notes.title: 🐱 Add our new game to wishlist! ⛄️
notes.notes:
Hey, guys! I hurry to share the news that we have announced our new game. For now we decided to take a little break from novels. This time it will be casual and simple - a game to find cats. 

I hope this game can warm you up a little bit in this snowy winter. Just look for the cats and enjoy all the shades of meow. It's free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2762810/Hidden_Winter_Cats/

The game is very casual and simple - you have to find 100 cats in a snowy location in 4k resolution. The art itself is hand drawn, as are all the cats. Most of them are easy to find, but some can be well hidden and shy of people. This is where the hint button will help you find the occasional hidden cat on the map. But don't use it too often - it has a cooldown.

You also have variability in choosing colors to paint - 5 bright colors that can be changed at any time in the pause menu. Red, blue, green, pink, yellow. You can paint different cats in different colors or make them all one color - at your discretion! Create your own painting. 

All cats are unique in both appearance and sounds. Some are happy to be found. Some, on the other hand, don't really want to be disturbed. Feel all the shades of meow! Also, the game has no words, is intuitive and suitable for all ages.

https://youtu.be/8y9k0X4sJiY

And finally the most important thing - the game is completely free! No paid content that is locked to you from the moment you start playing the game. If people like the game, the game will have sequels, with new unusual places to find cats. If you want to support the author - two DLCs are available, which do not affect the gameplay in any way. This is the soundtrack, which contains the main New Year's theme from the game. And this is the artbook, which is a 4k artwork containing a complete picture of the background and the kitties. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2788180/Hidden_Winter_Cats__Soundtrack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2789900/Hidden_Winter_Cats__Artbook/

But the most important support for me is your review on the game. It passes very quickly, in 2-5 minutes, but I hope it will manage to give you pleasant and positive emotions. So any feedback will be very useful for me and for potential sequels for the game. 

Best regards,
Faithy

notes.title: Soundtrack + Artbook DLC is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey guys! I really appreciate you playing my game and continuing to please with content and reviews. There is now a DLC out for another game of mine, Sunlight Scream, which has also had a good response from players. A few people have been asking me about the music from the game, so I've decided to release one generic DLC with the soundtrack and artbook from the game at a minimal price.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2653930/Sunlight_Scream__Soundtrack__Artbook/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635021/a903f33fceaebd181cc7530a63b077e137605f8c.jpg[/img]

All characters are available in their original size and full height, as they had to be compressed several times for the game. In addition, I decided to add content that you won't find in the main game - these are sketches and prototypes of the backgrounds and characters themselves from the game. You can see backgrounds you already know from the early stages of development. Due to issues with some of the artists, you may see some backgrounds in different styles, which were then reworked to match what you can see in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635021/c2275bfa8add61c50ffb8f08b1392a90dfe06323.jpg[/img]

It's very easy to use. After purchase, you just have a folder downloaded, which you open and see everything you need. The content is sorted into appropriate folders and localized into Russian and English.

However, I want to warn against possible spoilers! It would seem logical, but just in case - first go through the game itself, preferably several times, so as not to spoil your impression in the future from the details seen in the artbook.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635021/0a9c2f14e4f20d45927c204939849e2caf88d280.png[/img]

I would like to thank you all once again for your support and interest in the game, as I am a solo developer and have not invested in marketing in any way. Your opinion and feedback is very important for me to develop further and understand the direction for the next projects. Have a nice day! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635021/99a0ad88a0035b1317fc3a6252bb95cff2a78ad8.png[/img]

Best Regards, 
Faithy

notes.title: MAC support added!
notes.notes:
Unfortunately, neither I nor the testers have a MAC available to test the full functionality, but the build should work. The only question is the executable file. If you have any problems with the MAC version of the game, then post in the corresponding thread on the community forum of the game with bugs and I will try to fix it as soon as possible!

Also, I finally fixed the bugs with incorrect languages on first launch. Now the game should immediately launch in the user's language.

Sincerely,
Faithy

notes.title: Easy language switching directly from the main menu
notes.notes: I've gotten feedback from a few people that their preset languages don't match the version of the game that opens the first time. Although I customized builds for each supported language, apparently this is another bug of Steam, or I did something wrong. Anyway, now all you have to do is click on the right flag in the main menu to change the language to your native one if something goes wrong on first launch! Probably the same system I will use in [b]Sunlight Scream[/b] to minimize possible confusion.

notes.title: The long-awaited release of Sunlight Scream on Steam
notes.notes:
Greetings to all Experimentation fans! I'd like to solemnly present you my main game, which I've been working on for quite a long time, and which was described in one of the Experimentation stories. This is Sunlight Scream itself.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2608440/Sunlight_Scream_University_Massacre/?beta=0

The long-suffering visual novel finally got life on Steam. Get up, student! Study, girls, adventures, and most importantly - a killer in a mask! It's time to work as a detective and find out who is hiding under the mask, without getting under the knife. And preferably save your friends. At least once in a while. 

This is my first game, created entirely on my own and on pure enthusiasm. I put a lot of effort and persistence to make it, and I'm extremely happy that it finally appears on my favorite store - Steam. Looking at the current trend of prices in the store I decided to go against the mainstream - I lowered the price of the game by three times of the planned price. Feel free to add the game to your wishlist, buy it, create content!

And the most important thing at the moment is the release date. Due to Steam restrictions I will be able to release the game not earlier than [b]October 2, so be it.[/b]. 

In the meantime, here's some ice cream from Erika!
